name: date
description: Print or set the system date and time

name: -d
--date
options.description: Display time described by STRING, not 'now'

options.name: --resolution
options.description: Output the available resolution of timestamps

name: -R
--rfc-email
options.description: Output date and time in RFC 5322 format

options.name: --debug
options.description: Annotate the parsed date, and warn about questionable usage to stderr

name: -r
--reference
options.description: Display the last modification time of FILE

name: -u
--universal
options.description: Print or set Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) [aliases: --utc]
